verdict.rationale: Highnote exposes a GraphQL API with an interactive explorer. A GraphQL schema is a typed, machine-readable spec equivalent to OpenAPI, but the evidence never documents a downloadable schema file or introspection access. The probe found no OpenAPI or Swagger file at any of the standard paths. Missing for 10: a documented downloadable schema (GraphQL SDL or introspection) or OpenAPI file, a stable published URL for it, and hands-on confirmation that it can be fetched.
